collate_batched_R2N2: collate a list of R2N2 dataset dictionaries into stacked tensors for images, camera matrices, and voxels
compute_extrinsic_matrix: compute a 4x4 camera extrinsic matrix from azimuth, elevation, and distance parameters
read_binvox_coords: read a binvox file and return the coordinates of all nonzero voxels as a tensor
align_bbox: align source 3D points to a target coordinate system by applying per-axis scale and shift
render_cubified_voxels: convert a batch of voxel grids to meshes using cubify and render images with a shader
